subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox support this dedicated private AWS workspace service as a maintained deployment mode, and should this exact proof-positive branch be the canonical landing candidate instead of the divergent draft successor?
rationale: Code review and live acceptance establish that the implementation is credible, but they cannot decide whether the project should permanently own this specialized infrastructure and operations contract or which overlapping branch should define it.

options.title: Sponsor this proven branch
options.body: Accept the supported-service boundary and finish maintainer review on the exact head with authenticated lifecycle proof, reconciling only necessary successor-only hardening.

options.title: Consolidate into the successor
options.body: Make the draft successor canonical only after preserving every final fix and repeating the full authenticated canary on its exact final head.

options.title: Decline the supported mode
options.body: Pause or close both branches if the ongoing IAM, infrastructure, and operations contract is not worth maintaining.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this proven branch
recommendation.body: Accept the supported-service boundary and finish maintainer review on the exact head with authenticated lifecycle proof, reconciling only necessary successor-only hardening.
